notes: 2.1 - servo power failsafe: the servos stay powered only while the controller is alive, so a crash or reset cuts their power instead of leaving them running, and a deliberate stop also cuts it (a limit stop does not). Requires the failsafe circuit, which is on the base board. Also: the dashboard warns when it is showing a stale snapshot; the update badge no longer offers the version already installed; a dead quadrature channel is now named; defaults match the base board (absolute encoder pins 8/17, display rotation 3). Same firmware for base board v1.1 and the planned v1.2.
